card.text: Sun-like star 48 parsecs away in Pegasus that hosts the first known transiting planet.

introduction.text: HD 209458 is a Sun-like star 48 parsecs away in Pegasus, 1.16 times the Sun’s radius. Its giant planet crosses its face every 3.5 days.

shape.title: Sphere of the measured radius
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray. No picture of the surface is cast here.
